    testdata/export/prices.txtar: no registry claims out/Old/outcome: no column named Old runs over the corpus export.
        If a column should write them, register the column. If not, delete them by hand; FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... leaves them in place.
    testdata/export/prices.txtar: no registry claims out/my col/outcome: no column named my col runs over the corpus export.
        If a column should write them, register the column. If not, delete them by hand; FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... leaves them in place.
    testdata/export/prices.txtar: no registry claims via/Old/quote/A1: no bytes lift named Old runs over the corpus export.
